ports.note: Every layer port, on every map, whatever its parameters say. The ports used to vary with an inputMode parameter -- reasoningInput, rasterInput, polygonInput, networkInput were four separate declarations of that -- so the port a connection needed might not exist on the node. Which renderer draws is now read from what is wired: src/core.ts#drawnMode.

ontology.note: Map presentation plan and MapView activity are implemented; broader map artifact and cartographic contracts remain open. 0.11.0 declared fw:MapSpecification and the fifteen encoding properties here. That was wrong: emits records what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget is defined in src/core.ts#TYPES, which asserts nothing. The encoding terms are asserted by src/map-communication.ts and are gated by validate:ontology-coupling, which holds at zero undeclared. A release file is immutable, so 0.11.0 keeps the over-declaration and this one corrects it.

changes.description: A map over an online basemap writes a machined Methods limitation: the tiles are context, can change or go, and no value depends on them. Bundled ground writes none.
A polygon layer that carries a category is keyed by its classes, as the figure shades it. A layer classified by a ruleset was keyed by the value ranges it no longer showed.

An interactive map can import an OpenStreetMap extract as PMTiles, once, for what it draws, and keep it on the device. The workflow keeps the spec, not the tiles. A category now shades and keys the interactive map too.
An interactive map can label polygon parts with any attribute they carry, shown above the key they are joined on.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.17.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid.
